extracted.name: Cucumber Tomato Salad with Zucchini and Black Olives in Lemon Balsamic Vinaigrette
extracted.description: This cucumber tomato salad with zucchini and black olives in lemon balsamic vinaigrette recipe makes a flavorful salad with a bright, herbal dressing.
ingredient_lines: 1.25 teaspoons kosher salt, or to taste
instruction_lines: Mix cucumbers, zucchini, onion, tomatoes, olives, basil, and thyme together in a large bowl.
Whisk red wine vinegar, balsamic vinegar, lemon zest, lemon juice, salt, sugar, and pepper together in a medium bowl until well combined.
Slowly whisk oil into dressing mixture in a medium bowl until combined; pour over salad, and serve.
